title: Issue Management Record
description: Issue Management Record contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-issue-management-record
  title: Issue Management Record
  description: Issue Management Record contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_issue_management_record_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/issue_management_record
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/issue_management_record
    sourceVersion: fs_issue_management_record_v1
    sourceDigest: 0ad6ac762b44d32be20363755dd7ada0eee7409f4fd7cf7132851f361d7d4cf5
spec:
  role: exception
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Issue Management Record
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: opened-date
              name: opened_date
              label: Opened Date
              description: Date issue was opened.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: target-completion-date
              name: target_completion_date
              label: Target Completion Date
              description: Committed remediation target date.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: actual-completion-date
              name: actual_completion_date
              label: Actual Completion Date
              description: Actual completion date if closed.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: days-overdue
              name: days_overdue
              label: Days Overdue
              description: Days overdue if stated.
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: issue-id
              name: issue_id
              label: Issue Id
              description: Internal issue, MRA, MRIA, or audit finding identifier.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: source-type
              name: source_type
              label: Source Type
              description: Regulatory exam, internal audit, compliance testing, self-identified, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: issue-title
              name: issue_title
              label: Issue Title
              description: Short issue title.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: issue-description
              name: issue_description
              label: Issue Description
              description: Detailed issue or finding description.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: severity
              name: severity
              label: Severity
              description: Critical, high, medium, low, MRA, MRIA, or other severity.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: business-unit
              name: business_unit
              label: Business Unit
              description: Business unit responsible for remediation.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: corrective-action-plan
              name: corrective_action_plan
              label: Corrective Action Plan
              description: Summary of remediation plan.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: milestones
              name: milestones
              label: Milestones
              description: Key milestones or deliverables.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: evidence-required
              name: evidence_required
              label: Evidence Required
              description: Evidence expected for closure.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: source-name
              name: source_name
              label: Source Name
              description: Regulator, audit group, testing program, or source.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: owner-name
              name: owner_name
              label: Owner Name
              description: Accountable issue owner.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: validation-owner
              name: validation_owner
              label: Validation Owner
              description: Independent validation owner or function.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: risk-domain
              name: risk_domain
              label: Risk Domain
              description: Compliance, credit, operational, model, cyber, liquidity, or other domain.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: status
              name: status
              label: Status
              description: Open, in progress, pending validation, closed, overdue, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: validation-status
              name: validation_status
              label: Validation Status
              description: Not started, in progress, passed, failed, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: regulatory-commitment
              name: regulatory_commitment
              label: Regulatory Commitment
              description: Whether issue is tied to a regulatory commitment.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
  validationRules:
    - id: issue-id-present
      severity: error
      description: issue_id is required for Issue Management Record extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: issue_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: issue_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: issue_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(issue_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: issue-title-present
      severity: error
      description: issue_title is required for Issue Management Record extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: issue_title
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: issue_title
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: issue_title IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(issue_title)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: status-present
      severity: error
      description: status is required for Issue Management Record extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: status
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: status
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: status IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(status)) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      issue_id:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Issue Management Record workflow.
      issue_title:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Issue Management Record workflow.
      severity:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Issue Management Record workflow.
      target_completion_date:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Issue Management Record workflow.
      status:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Issue Management Record workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Issue Management Record documents combine structured fields and narrative risk/legal/compliance context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      issue_id:
        type: string
        description: Internal issue, MRA, MRIA, or audit finding identifier.
      source_type:
        type: string
        description: Regulatory exam, internal audit, compliance testing, self-identified, or other.
      source_name:
        type: string
        description: Regulator, audit group, testing program, or source.
      issue_title:
        type: string
        description: Short issue title.
      issue_description:
        type: string
        description: Detailed issue or finding description.
      risk_domain:
        type: string
        description: Compliance, credit, operational, model, cyber, liquidity, or other domain.
      severity:
        type: string
        description: Critical, high, medium, low, MRA, MRIA, or other severity.
      status:
        type: string
        description: Open, in progress, pending validation, closed, overdue, or other.
      owner_name:
        type: string
        description: Accountable issue owner.
      business_unit:
        type: string
        description: Business unit responsible for remediation.
      opened_date:
        type: date
        description: Date issue was opened.
        format: date
      target_completion_date:
        type: date
        description: Committed remediation target date.
        format: date
      actual_completion_date:
        type: date
        description: Actual completion date if closed.
        format: date
      corrective_action_plan:
        type: string
        description: Summary of remediation plan.
      milestones:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Key milestones or deliverables.
      evidence_required:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Evidence expected for closure.
      validation_owner:
        type: string
        description: Independent validation owner or function.
      validation_status:
        type: string
        description: Not started, in progress, passed, failed, or other.
      regulatory_commitment:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether issue is tied to a regulatory commitment.
      days_overdue:
        type: integer
        description: Days overdue if stated.
    required:
      - issue_id
      - issue_title
      - status
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - issue_id
            - issue_title
            - status
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
